synopsis: Tatooine Manhunt is a Star Wars Legends adventure book for use with Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game. The adventure scenario pits Rebel Alliance agents against bounty hunters in a desperate search for the elusive hero Adar Tallon on the desert planet Tatooine.The Tatooine Manhunt set includes a double-sided color map of the Mos Eisley Cantina and Spaceport, as well as a Star Warriors combat scenario with full-color counters. Tatooine Manhunt was written by Bill Slavicsek and Daniel Greenberg, and published by West End Games in 1988.
title: Tatooine Manhunt
